name: coss
title_zh: 写 coss 组件时替你避开 Base UI 那些坑
tagline_zh: 从 shadcn/Radix 迁过来时最容易翻车的不是样式。
tagline_en: Migrating from shadcn/Radix? The real breakage is trigger composition and a11y props. Get per-component imports.
desc_en: Helps implement coss UI components correctly. Use when building UIs with coss primitives and patterns (buttons, dialogs, selects, forms, menus, tabs, segmented controls, inputs, toasts, etc.), migrating from shadcn/Radix to coss/Base UI, composing trigger-based overlays, or troubleshooting coss component behavior. Covers imports, accessibility, Tailwind styling, and common pitfalls.
why_zh: 按组件而非按概念组织：按钮、对话框、Select、Tabs 各自一节，讲清 import 路径。
why_en: Organized per component, not per concept: buttons, dialogs, selects, tabs each get imports, a11y requirements, and pitfalls. A.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 coss/Base UI 这一套组件库，用 Radix、MUI 或原生表单时帮不上；它给的是写法和避坑说明。
limit_en: Only covers coss/Base UI. Useless for Radix, MUI, or native forms. Gives patterns and pitfall notes, not full pages or visual design decisions.
title_en: A coss component reference that steers you around Base UI.
